a:r.a:t: ENTERPRISE GRADE AI
TALK TRACK
OPENING:
"Let me show you what separates enterprise AI from the chatbots you've probably seen fail. There are five things that make AI actually work at scale."
1. MULTI-MODEL, MULTI-PROVIDER
On slide: Right model for each task. No single point of failure. Optimized for quality, latency, and cost.
Say this:

"First, we're not locked into a single AI provider. We use the right model for each task - Anthropic for nuanced conversations, OpenAI for speed, Gemini for certain reasoning tasks. This isn't just about performance - it's about resilience. When OpenAI has an outage, your customer experience doesn't go down with it. And we're constantly optimizing the balance of quality, latency, and cost."
Key insight: "Your competitors using single-vendor AI are one outage away from a customer experience crisis."
2. CONTEXT-AWARE
On slide: Grounded in customer history, knowledge bases, and verified sources. Factual and personalized.
Say this:

"Second, context-awareness. Generic AI hallucinates because it's guessing. Our AI is grounded - in the customer's actual history, your verified knowledge base, your brand guidelines. When a customer asks 'where's my order?' we're not generating a creative response - we're pulling their specific order status and responding with facts."
Key insight: "Grounding is the difference between AI that sounds helpful and AI that IS helpful."
3. SECURE INTEGRATIONS
On slide: Connected to CRMs, commerce, and ops systems. Real actions: orders, returns, claims.
Say this:

"Third, secure integrations. Our AI doesn't just talk - it acts. It's connected to Shopify, Salesforce, your OMS, your returns system. When a customer wants to track an order, cancel a subscription, or process a return, the AI actually does it. Securely, with full audit trails. We have 50+ pre-built integrations and open APIs for everything else."
Key insight: "AI that can only answer questions is just a fancy FAQ. AI that takes action is a workforce multiplier."
4. SAFEGUARDS
On slide: Tone, brand, and compliance checks on every response. Hallucination detection built-in.
Say this:

"Fourth, safeguards. Every response passes through tone checks, brand compliance, and hallucination detection before it reaches your customer. We catch promises the AI shouldn't make, we flag responses that might be off-brand, and we have confidence thresholds that automatically escalate when the AI isn't sure. This isn't bolted on - it's built into every interaction."
Key insight: "The risk of AI isn't that it fails - it's that it fails confidently. Safeguards catch confident failures before they reach customers."
5. HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP
On slide: AI augments agents with suggestions. Low confidence or sensitive topics escalate to humans.
Say this:

"Finally, human-in-the-loop. AI should augment your team, not replace judgment. When conversations get complex, emotional, or high-stakes, they escalate to humans - seamlessly, with full context. And for your agents, AI provides real-time suggestions, summaries, and next-best-actions. This works with Gladly Team or your existing helpdesk."
Key insight: "The best AI knows what it doesn't know - and hands off gracefully."
CLOSING / TRANSITION

"This is what enterprise-grade means. Not a demo that looks good, but AI that holds up at scale, under pressure, with real customers. Multi-model resilience. Grounded responses. Real integrations. Built-in safeguards. Human escalation when it matters."
[CONNECT TO RETAIL EXPERTISE - optional addition]

"And here's what makes Gladly different from generic AI platforms: we've spent 11 years focused exclusively on retail and ecommerce CX. 300 million retail conversations. 270+ retail customers. That expertise is baked into everything - the way we handle returns, recognize purchase intent, know when to upsell and when to just solve the problem. When you work with a generic AI vendor, they're learning your industry on your dime. When you work with Gladly, you're building on a decade of proven expertise."
OBJECTION HANDLERS
"We're worried about AI hallucinations"

→ "You should be - that's the #1 risk with generic AI. Our safeguards include hallucination detection, fact-checking against your knowledge base, and confidence thresholds that escalate uncertain responses to humans. We don't let the AI guess."
"We've tried AI chatbots and they failed"

→ "Most chatbots fail because they're disconnected - no customer context, no system integrations, no safeguards. They're just generating text. We're different: grounded in your data, connected to your systems, with humans in the loop when it matters."
"How do you handle sensitive customer data?"

→ "All data stays within your security perimeter. We don't train models on your customer data. Every integration is SOC 2 compliant with full audit trails. And human escalation ensures sensitive conversations get human judgment."
"What happens when the AI is wrong?"

→ "Two layers of protection: first, safeguards catch most errors before they reach customers. Second, confidence thresholds automatically escalate uncertain responses. When something does slip through, the full conversation is logged for review and continuous improvement."
KEY DIFFERENTIATORS TO EMPHASIZE
• Multi-model = resilience (no single point of failure)
• Grounding = accuracy (facts, not fabrication)
• Integrations = action (not just answers)
• Safeguards = trust (catches errors before customers see them)
• Human-in-the-loop = judgment (AI knows its limits)
